subject.title: Dashboard: chart widgets + widget authoring SDK

question: Should this stacked dashboard PR be allowed to carry dependency-graph and security-sensitive dashboard stack changes, or must it be rebased/narrowed before review continues?
rationale: The dependency guard and CODEOWNERS make this a human security/repository-policy choice; automated review cannot approve dependency graph changes or the stacked custom-widget security boundary.

options.title: Rebase and narrow before merge
options.body: Wait for the base dashboard PRs to land or rebase this branch so this PR only carries the chart and authoring-SDK delta, then re-run dependency/proof review.

options.title: Approve current dependency graph
options.body: A repository admin or secops reviewer can intentionally approve the current head SHA and own the cumulative dependency/security review burden.

options.title: Pause the feature stack
options.body: If the dashboard stack is not product-approved for core yet, leave the PR open for maintainer direction rather than trying to repair it automatically.

recommendation.title: Rebase and narrow before merge
recommendation.body: Wait for the base dashboard PRs to land or rebase this branch so this PR only carries the chart and authoring-SDK delta, then re-run dependency/proof review.

likelyOwner.reason: The immediate merge blocker is the dependency/security-boundary approval surfaced by CODEOWNERS and the dependency-graph guard.
